# Claude Allowed Tools - LPZRobots Actual Usage
# Based on thorough codebase analysis - only tools that are ACTUALLY USED

# Core shells
Bash(bash:*),Bash(sh:*),

# Version control (heavily used)
Bash(git:*),Bash(gh:*),Bash(diff:*),Bash(patch:*),

# File operations (all frequently used)
Bash(ls:*),Bash(cp:*),Bash(mv:*),Bash(rm:*),Bash(mkdir:*),Bash(rmdir:*),Bash(touch:*),Bash(ln:*),Bash(cd:*),Bash(pwd:*),Bash(basename:*),Bash(dirname:*),Bash(cat:*),Bash(head:*),Bash(tail:*),Bash(grep:*),Bash(find:*),Bash(xargs:*),Bash(sort:*),Bash(uniq:*),Bash(cut:*),Bash(tr:*),Bash(echo:*),Bash(file:*),Bash(wc:*),Bash(tar:*),Bash(gzip:*),Bash(zip:*),Bash(unzip:*),

# Text processing (heavily used in scripts)
Bash(sed:*),Bash(awk:*),

# Build systems (primary tools)
Bash(make:*),Bash(cmake:*),Bash(autoconf:*),Bash(automake:*),Bash(libtool:*),Bash(m4:*),Bash(pkg-config:*),

# Package managers (used in CI)
Bash(apt:*),Bash(apt-get:*),Bash(brew:*),

# C++ compilation (essential)
Bash(gcc:*),Bash(g++:*),Bash(clang:*),Bash(clang++:*),Bash(ar:*),Bash(ld:*),

# Code quality (used in CI)
Bash(cppcheck:*),Bash(clang-tidy:*),Bash(clang-format:*),

# Testing
Bash(test:*),Bash([[:*),

# Permissions
Bash(chmod:*),

# Process control
Bash(ps:*),Bash(kill:*),

# System info
Bash(uname:*),Bash(which:*),

# Shell scripting essentials
Bash(if:*),Bash(then:*),Bash(else:*),Bash(fi:*),Bash(for:*),Bash(do:*),Bash(done:*),Bash(true),Bash(false),

# Environment
Bash(export:*),Bash(source:*),

# Video processing (used in utils)
Bash(ffmpeg:*),Bash(avconv:*),

# LPZRobots scripts
Bash(./start:*),Bash(./createNewSimulation.sh:*),

# Claude helpers
Task,TodoWrite,Read,Write,Edit,Replace,MultiEdit,Glob,Grep,WebFetch(domain:**)
